arena.assumptions: 1200HP/75 power/1Hz/50 defense hypothetical reference, fixed N on one team; aggressive neutral in same-cell arena, no walkable exits, deterministic random .5. Actual uses neutral runtime; draft uses only five proposed stats with other effects zero. Engine regeneration is OUT OF COMBAT ONLY, 5s after combat; analytical draft instead assumes in-combat HPS. Neither reference nor proposed DNA is a validated producible build.

dna.proof: Each grade-g piece introduces g previously unoccupied internal path cells. The board has 91 cells; its occupied origin leaves at most 90 internal cells. Thus sum(grade*count) <= 90. Blade needs at least one internal cell; power/speed bounds reserve that cell. These are certified upper bounds, not asserted attainable maxima. Witnesses are native-trace-valid lower bounds.
